verdict.rationale: Shortwave documents 'AI Snippets' that let users define an email template once and reuse it, available for individual and team use — directly matching the core snippet/template story. However, the evidence never confirms support for variables (dynamic fields) within snippets or attaching files as part of a snippet, both explicitly requested in the story. Missing for 10: documentation of variable/placeholder support in snippets, documentation of attachment bundling with snippets, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the feature working as described.
